changelogEntries.body:
Switching FakeQuoteKind from NEWSLETTER_PROFILE to ORDER or another
payload type previously kept non-empty newsletterJid/profileName fields
active in buildContextInfoJson, unintentionally combining newsletter
forwarding metadata onto unrelated fake quotes.

Only attach forwardedNewsletterMessageInfo when NEWSLETTER_PROFILE is
selected or the new "Combine with Channel / Profile Spoof" toggle is
explicitly enabled in FakeQuoteSheet.

changelogEntries.message: perf(chat-ui): prevent ANR on 50k-100k+ char messages and fix read more
changelogEntries.body:
Huge text, quoted replies, and multi-line payloads previously caused
main-thread hangs or truncated "Read more" expansion:
- MediaSummaryParser ran DOT_MATCHES_ALL regexes across 100k-char strings
- WhatsAppTextLinks scanned all tokens with O(N^2) overlap checks
- Single Compose Text nodes over 8k chars overflowed HWUI textures
- computeTextPhaseWindow only checked charBudget while maxLines clipped
  separately, hiding "Read more" early on newline-heavy messages

Replace regex summary parsing with O(1) prefix scanners, use binary
search and span caps in WhatsAppTextFormatter, split large texts into
4,096-char Column chunks, and unify line/character truncation in
computeTextPhaseWindow with progressive expansion up to 512k chars.

changelogEntries.message: perf(messages): bound quoted message summary prefix to 512 chars
changelogEntries.body:
Quoting a 50k-100k+ character message previously embedded the entire
quoted body into the `[Quote: id|participant|text]` summary prefix,
inflating SQLite rows and causing UI parser stalls on Android.

Sanitize and truncate the quoted preview text in a single pass at 512
characters while preserving `[Quote: ...]` delimiter safety.

changelogEntries.message: perf(ui): optimize chat list, wallpaper, theme, and message components
changelogEntries.body:
Reduces recomposition and allocation overhead across chat list, message,
wallpaper, and theme components, fixes nullable callback return types in
ChatListScreen, and scopes ThemeManager prefs cache by context identity.

changelogEntries.message: perf(app,service): optimize startup, raw logger, and keep-alive services
changelogEntries.body:
Streamlines application/activity initialization, raw message logging,
floating keep-alive/foreground tracking, and updates ConnectionRecoveryTest.

changelogEntries.message: perf(service): offload BootReceiver work via goAsync on IO dispatcher
changelogEntries.body:
Moves SharedPreferences, file cleanup, and service start handling off
the main receiver thread with credential-storage error guards.

changelogEntries.message: feat(app): add stealth metadata, call blocker, fake quotes, and perf fixes
changelogEntries.body:
Adds privacy stealth metadata settings, call blocking, fake quote and
spoiler UI/plugin support, sticker sound coordination, bounded caches,
backlog-only chat update throttling, and updated unit test coverage.

changelogEntries.message: chore(scripts): update native build helper utilities
changelogEntries.body:
Refine symbol validation and packaging helper scripts for release
artifact checks.

changelogEntries.message: feat(ffi): sync UniFFI bindings and plugin API catalog
changelogEntries.body:
Updates generated Kotlin bindings, plugin API dispatch table, and docs
for LID conversion, fake quotes, and stealth metadata configuration.

changelogEntries.message: feat(ffi): expose stealth metadata, fake quote, and LID lookup bindings
changelogEntries.body:
Add UniFFI client bindings for BotPluginMetadata stealth configuration,
fake quote dispatch, and LID/PN contact resolution.

changelogEntries.message: feat(core): harden socket reconnects, stealth metadata, and LID/status flows
changelogEntries.body:
Fixes socket/connection stall recovery, adds BotPluginMetadata stealth
injection, and expands companion, LID conversion, and status handling.

changelogEntries.message: refactor(store): harden SQLite catalog, file store, and serialization
changelogEntries.body:
Consolidates SQLite schema/query catalog helpers, enforces zero-allocation
buffer JSON decoding, and tightens store trait error handling and fs safety.

changelogEntries.message: refactor(security): strengthen obfuscation and zeroize crypto, noise, and signal
changelogEntries.body:
Hardens compile-time seed derivation in baileys-obf and applies consistent
zeroization, literal protection, and cipher/session safety across
crypto, noise, proto, and signal crates.

changelogEntries.message: build(cargo): harden workspace dependencies, SQLite flags, and linker options
changelogEntries.body:
Switches to resolver 3, enables zeroize on RustCrypto primitives,
tightens default features on rustls/reqwest/chrono/regex, hardens
SQLite compile flags, and configures linker/strip flags per target.

changelogEntries.message: feat(tools): add standalone channel-status-fetch live inspector
changelogEntries.body:
Adds a standalone CLI tool for inspecting WhatsApp channel_status links
and newsletter status wire responses.
